examples.arabic: السفرة مليانة اكل مصري شهي زي الملوخية والرز والمحشي وكلنا قعدنا حواليها
examples.english: The dining table was full of delicious Egyptian food like molokhia, rice, and mahshi, and we all sat around it.
examples.transliteration: El sofra malyana akl masri shahi zay el molokheya we el rozz we el mahshi we kollena qa'adna hawalayha

examples.arabic: الرز والمحاشي شكلهم كويس جدا وعايزين ناكل بسرعة
examples.english: The rice and stuffed vegetables look very good and we want to eat quickly.
examples.transliteration: Er-rozz wel-maḥāshī shaklihum kwayyis giddan w ʿayzīn nākol bi-surʿa.

examples.arabic: في الآخر بقي اكتشفنا انها عملت طبق كشري تاني بس بالفاكهة مش بالرز
examples.english: In the end, we discovered that she made another koshary dish, but with fruit instead of rice.
examples.transliteration: Fel akher ba2a ektashafna enaha 3amalet taba2 koshary tany bas bel fakha mesh bel rozz

examples.arabic: على العشا شاف سمك و رز و خضار
examples.english: At dinner, he saw fish, rice, and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: ʕala l-ʕasha shāf samak w rozz w khoḍaar.

examples.english: The food was rice and fish.
examples.transliteration: El akl kan rozz w samak.

examples.arabic: شفت رز وخضار من امبارح وفكرت ايه ده ده مش حلو للفطار خالص
examples.english: I saw rice and vegetables from yesterday, and I thought: "What is this? This is not good for breakfast at all."
examples.transliteration: Shoft rozz we khoḍaar men embareḥ we fakart "Eeh da? Da mush ḥelw lel feṭaar khaleṣ".
